intelligence.enrichment: Different animals have different types of movement such as flying, running, crawling, walking, hopping, or jumping, and they use body parts such as wings, legs, and other parts for moving from one place to another. movement_type_and_body_parts -> animal_group The learner correctly applies this rule: Different animals have different types of movement such as flying, running, crawling, walking, hopping, or jumping, and they use body parts such as wings, legs, and other parts for moving from one place to another. Animal movement groups are based on the animal's familiar name or size; the body parts used for movement do not matter.
